summary: Euroholdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 24, 2026, attaching a press release announcing results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on July 23, 2026. Shareholders elected two Class B directors (Panagiotis Kyriakopoulos and Christos Triantafillidis) and ratified Deloitte as independent auditors for the year ending December 31, 2026. This is a routine annual meeting report with no special-situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other corporate action. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer current report on routine governance matters.
